youtube.title: MONEY TALKS
youtube.summary: Farzin Irani of Sovereignty Capital warns that changing global economic conditions could have serious implications for New Zealanders, from falling property values and rising mortgage costs to the risks of using KiwiSaver to enter the housing market. He also examines the potential consequences of bank failures, digital banking and government-issued digital credentials, arguing that financial independence and genuine international diversification are increasingly important. Farzin’s event Capital Intelligence is an opportunity for people to learn more about the financial and global developments discussed to be held on 28 November 2026.
